answer_en: Matsya Samrudhi grants up to 50% capital subsidy for biofloc fish farming, freshwater carp rearing, and ornamental fisheries. Apply at the Matsya Bhavan.
answer_ml: മത്സ്യ സമൃദ്ധി പദ്ധതിയിലൂടെ ബയോഫ്ലോക്ക്, കൂട് കൃഷി, ശുദ്ധജല മത്സ്യകൃഷി എന്നിവ ആരംഭിക്കുന്നതിന് 40% മുതൽ 50% വരെ സർക്കാർ സബ്‌സിഡി ലഭ്യമാണ്. മത്സ്യഭവനുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെടുക.
answer_hi: मत्स्य समृद्धि योजना के तहत बायोफ्लॉक और मीठे पानी में मछली पालन शुरू करने के लिए 40% से 50% तक सरकारी सब्सिडी दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Matsya Samrudhi me biofloc fish farming aur pond aquaculture start karne ke liye 40% to 50% capital subsidy milti hai Matsya Bhavan se.

name: Thalolam Scheme (Free Treatment for Children)
benefit: 100% free specialized medical treatment, chemotherapy, cardiac surgery, and medicines up to ₹50,000 (and extended as needed) for children aged 0 to 18 suffering from critical conditions.
eligibility: All children aged 0-18 years belonging to BPL/poor families in Kerala admitted to government medical college hospitals or SAT hospital.
documents: Ration Card, Child Birth Certificate/Aadhaar, Medical College Case Sheet.
answer_en: Thalolam provides 100% free hospital treatment and surgeries for children aged 0-18 suffering from critical diseases in Kerala government medical colleges.
answer_ml: താലോലം പദ്ധതി വഴി 18 വയസ്സ് വരെയുള്ള കുട്ടികൾക്ക് ഉണ്ടാകുന്ന ഗുരുതര രോഗങ്ങൾക്കുള്ള ചികിത്സയും ശസ്ത്രക്രിയകളും സർക്കാർ മെഡിക്കൽ കോളേജുകളിൽ പൂർണ്ണമായും സൗജന്യമാണ്.
answer_hi: तालोलम योजना के तहत 18 वर्ष तक के बच्चों को सरकारी मेडिकल कॉलेजों में गंभीर बीमारियों का इलाज और सर्जरी 100% मुफ्त दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Thalolam scheme me 0-18 age ke bachhon ko government medical colleges me complex surgeries aur critical treatment completely free milta hai.

name: Kanyaka Pension (Unmarried Women 50+)
benefit: Monthly pension of ₹1,600 directly into the bank accounts of unmarried women aged 50 years and above from low-income families.
eligibility: Unmarried women aged 50+ resident of Kerala with annual family income under ₹1,00,000.
documents: Age Proof (Aadhaar/School Certificate), Unmarried Certificate from Village Officer, Income Certificate, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Kanyaka Pension grants ₹1,600 monthly pension to unmarried women aged 50 and above belonging to low-income households. Apply at your Grama Panchayat or Municipality.
answer_ml: കന്യക പെൻഷൻ പദ്ധതിയിലൂടെ 50 വയസ്സ് കഴിഞ്ഞ അവിവാഹിതരായ നിർധന സ്ത്രീകൾക്ക് മാന്യമായ ഉപജീവനത്തിനായി പ്രതിമാസം ₹1,600 പെൻഷൻ നൽകുന്നു.
answer_hi: कन्यका पेंशन योजना के तहत 50 वर्ष से अधिक उम्र की अविवाहित गरीब महिलाओं को ₹1,600 प्रति माह पेंशन दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Kanyaka Pension scheme me 50+ unmarried women ko dignified living ke liye monthly ₹1,600 direct bank pension milti hai.

name: Punjab Free 300 Units Domestic Electricity Scheme
benefit: 300 units of completely free domestic electricity per month (600 units on bi-monthly billing cycles), resulting in zero power bills for nearly 90% of households.
eligibility: All domestic residential electricity consumers in Punjab consuming up to 600 units bi-monthly.
documents: PSPCL Electricity Connection Account Number, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Punjab Free Electricity Scheme gives 300 units of free electricity per month (600 units bi-monthly) to all domestic consumers, making power bills zero.
answer_pa: ਪੰਜਾਬ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਸਾਰੇ ਘਰੇਲੂ ਖਪਤਕਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਮਹੀਨਾ 300 ਯੂਨਿਟ (ਦੋ ਮਹੀਨਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਬਿੱਲ ਵਿੱਚ 600 ਯੂਨਿਟ) ਮੁਫਤ ਬਿਜਲੀ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਨਾਲ ਬਿੱਲ ਜ਼ੀਰੋ ਆਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
answer_hi: पंजाब मुफ्त बिजली योजना के तहत सभी घरेलू उपभोक्ताओं को हर महीने 300 यूनिट (दो महीने के बिल पर 600 यूनिट) मुफ्त बिजली दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Punjab Free Power scheme me domestic consumers ko 300 units per month free bijli milti hai jisse bill completely zero ho jaata hai.

name: Aam Aadmi Clinics (Mohalla Clinics Punjab)
benefit: 100% free consultation by MBBS doctors, 80+ free essential clinical diagnostic lab tests, and 40+ free medicines at neighbourhood walk-in clinics.
eligibility: Open to all residents and citizens across urban and rural Punjab with zero fees.
documents: No identity document required. Direct digital token registration.
answer_en: Aam Aadmi Clinics provide free doctor checkups, 80+ free laboratory tests, and free branded medicines across 800+ neighbourhood clinics in Punjab.
answer_pa: ਆਮ ਆਦਮੀ ਕਲੀਨਿਕਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਾਹਰ ਡਾਕਟਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ, 80 ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਲੈਬ ਟੈਸਟ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ ਦਵਾਈਆਂ ਬਿਲਕੁਲ ਮੁਫਤ ਦਿੱਤੀਆਂ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ।
answer_hi: आम आदमी क्लिनिक में एमबीबीएस डॉक्टरों द्वारा मुफ्त जांच, 80 से अधिक मुफ्त लैब टेस्ट और मुफ्त दवाएं सभी नागरिकों को दी जाती हैं।
answer_hinglish: Aam Aadmi Clinics me neighbourhood clinics me free doctor consultation, 80+ free diagnostic tests aur free medicines milti hain.

name: Ashirwad Scheme (Shagun Scheme Punjab)
benefit: One-time financial grant of ₹51,000 credited directly into the bride's bank account for solemnization of marriage.
eligibility: Girls aged 18+ belonging to SC, BC, Christian, Muslim, and EWS families in Punjab with family annual income under ₹32,790.
documents: Bride & Groom Age Proof, Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Wedding Invitation Card, Bride's Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Punjab Ashirwad Scheme provides ₹51,000 direct bank grant for daughter's marriage to SC, BC, and low-income families. Apply on the Dr. Ambedkar portal.
answer_pa: ਅਸ਼ੀਰਵਾਦ (ਸ਼ਗਨ) ਸਕੀਮ ਅਧੀਨ ਅਨੁਸੂਚਿਤ ਜਾਤੀਆਂ, ਪਛੜੀਆਂ ਸ਼੍ਰੇਣੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਗਰੀਬ ਪਰਿਵਾਰਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਧੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਆਹ ਲਈ ₹51,000 ਦੀ ਵਿੱਤੀ ਸਹਾਇਤਾ ਸਿੱਧੀ ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
answer_hi: आशीर्वाद योजना के तहत गरीब परिवारों और दलित समुदाय की बेटियों के विवाह के लिए ₹51,000 की शगुन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Ashirwad scheme me beti ki marriage ke liye government ₹51,000 direct bank transfer shagun provide karti hai.

name: Ayushman Bharat Mukh Mantri Sehat Bima Yojana
benefit: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 900+ empanelled government and private hospitals in Punjab and Chandigarh.
eligibility: NFSA blue ration card holders, J-Form farmer holders, small traders, construction workers, and accredited journalists in Punjab.
documents: Sehat Bima E-Card, Ration Card, J-Form / Registration ID, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Sarbat Sehat Bima offers up to ₹5 Lakh cashless hospital treatment per family annually for 1,500+ procedures across network hospitals in Punjab.
answer_pa: ਸਰਬੱਤ ਸਿਹਤ ਬੀਮਾ ਯੋਜਨਾ ਤਹਿਤ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਦੇ ਲਗਭਗ 40 ਲੱਖ ਪਰਿਵਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਸਾਲ ₹5 ਲੱਖ ਤੱਕ ਦਾ ਮੁਫਤ ਕੈਸ਼ਲੈਸ ਇਲਾਜ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਹਸਪਤਾਲਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ।
answer_hi: सरबत सेहत बीमा योजना के तहत पंजाब के पात्र परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस इलाज सूचीबद्ध अस्पतालों में मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: Sarbat Sehat Bima scheme me family ko saal me ₹5 Lakh tak ka cashless medical treatment milta hai empanelled hospitals me.

name: Punjab Old Age & Social Security Pension
benefit: Monthly pension of ₹1,500 directly transferred into the bank accounts of senior citizens, widows, destitutes, and disabled persons.
eligibility: Senior citizens (men 65+, women 58+) resident of Punjab with family annual income less than ₹60,000.
documents: Age proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID), Income Certificate, Bank Passbook, Passport photo.
answer_en: Punjab Old Age Pension provides ₹1,500 per month directly into bank accounts of elderly citizens aged 65+ (men) or 58+ (women). Apply via Sewa Kendra.
answer_pa: ਪੰਜਾਬ ਬੁਢਾਪਾ ਪੈਨਸ਼ਨ ਸਕੀਮ ਤਹਿਤ 65 ਸਾਲ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਉਮਰ ਦੇ ਬਜ਼ੁਰਗਾਂ ਅਤੇ 58 ਸਾਲ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਉਮਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਮਹਿਲਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਮਹੀਨਾ ₹1,500 ਪੈਨਸ਼ਨ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਸੇਵਾ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਵਿਖੇ ਅਪਲਾਈ ਕਰੋ।
answer_hi: पंजाब वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना के तहत बुजुर्गों और विधवाओं को ₹1,500 प्रति माह पेंशन सीधे बैंक खाते में दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Punjab Old Age Pension me senior citizens aur widows ko har mahine ₹1,500 direct bank transfer pension milti hai.

name: Khedan Watan Punjab Diyan
benefit: Massive state sports games with cash prizes up to ₹7,00,000 for gold medalists, Olympic preparation grants up to ₹15,00,000, and sports government jobs.
eligibility: Athletes and sportspersons across 8 age groups (under-14 to veteran 70+) resident in Punjab.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Birth Certificate, Sports Federation/School Record.
answer_en: Khedan Watan Punjab Diyan promotes sports talent with cash awards up to ₹7 Lakh and Olympic athlete grants. Register at khedanwatanpunjabdia.com.
answer_pa: ਖੇਡਾਂ ਵਤਨ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਦੀਆਂ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਕਰੋੜਾਂ ਰੁਪਏ ਦੇ ਨਕਦ ਇਨਾਮ, ਓਲੰਪਿਕ ਤਿਆਰੀ ਲਈ ₹15 ਲੱਖ ਦੀ ਗ੍ਰਾਂਟ ਅਤੇ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਨੌਕਰੀਆਂ ਦਿੱਤੀਆਂ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ।
answer_hi: खेड़ां वतन पंजाब दियां योजना के तहत खिलाड़ियों को करोड़ों के नकद पुरस्कार, तैयारी अनुदान और सरकारी नौकरियां दी जाती हैं।
answer_hinglish: Khedan Watan Punjab Diyan me sportspersons ko cash awards, training subsidies aur government sports quota jobs milti hain.

name: Punjab Smart Ration (Atta-Dal) Scheme
benefit: Free wheat (or packaged clean wheat flour / Atta) delivered directly in hygienic packaged bags to the doorstep of BPL households.
eligibility: Blue Smart Ration Card holders covered under NFSA and state welfare food security schemes in Punjab.
documents: Smart Ration Card, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Punjab Smart Ration (Atta-Dal) distributes free packaged wheat flour and foodgrains directly to beneficiaries' homes without long queues.
answer_pa: ਸਮਾਰਟ ਰਾਸ਼ਨ ਕਾਰਡ (ਆਟਾ-ਦਾਲ) ਸਕੀਮ ਤਹਿਤ ਗਰੀਬ ਪਰਿਵਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਫ਼ ਪੈਕਡ ਆਟਾ ਅਤੇ ਕਣਕ ਘਰ-ਘਰ ਪਹੁੰਚਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਫਤ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
answer_hi: स्मार्ट राशन (आटा-दाल) योजना के तहत पंजाब के राशन कार्ड धारकों को उनके घर पर ही मुफ्त साफ गेहूं और आटा पहुंचाया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Atta-Dal scheme me Punjab ke NFSA families ko packaged wheat flour directly doorstep pe deliver kiya jaata hai free of cost.

name: Mai Bhago Vidya Scheme (Free Cycles for Girls)
benefit: Free standard lady bi-cycles distributed to girl students of classes 9, 10, 11, and 12 studying in government schools to ensure zero dropouts.
eligibility: Girl students enrolled in classes 9 to 12 in Punjab government high and senior secondary schools.
documents: School Registration ID, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Mai Bhago Vidya Scheme gifts free bicycles to high school girl students in government schools so they can commute safely and complete their education.
answer_pa: ਮਾਈ ਭਾਗੋ ਵਿੱਦਿਆ ਸਕੀਮ ਤਹਿਤ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਸਕੂਲਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ 9ਵੀਂ ਤੋਂ 12ਵੀਂ ਜਮਾਤ ਦੀਆਂ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥਣਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਕੂਲ ਆਉਣ-ਜਾਣ ਲਈ ਮੁਫਤ ਸਾਈਕਲ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
answer_hi: माई भागो विद्या योजना के तहत सरकारी स्कूलों की 9वीं से 12वीं की छात्राओं को मुफ्त साइकिलें वितरित की जाती हैं।
answer_hinglish: Mai Bhago Vidya scheme me 9th to 12th class government school girls ko commuting ease ke liye free lady bi-cycles provide ki jaati hain.

name: Mukh Mantri Tirath Yatra Scheme
benefit: 100% free pilgrimage travel by AC trains and deluxe buses to Sri Hazur Sahib, Sri Patna Sahib, Varanasi, Vrindavan, and Salasar with free AC hotel stay and food.
eligibility: Senior citizens and citizens of Punjab who are not government employees or income tax payers.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Punjab Domicile Proof, Medical Fitness Certificate.
answer_en: Mukh Mantri Tirath Yatra provides free AC train travel, hotel lodging, and food for citizens visiting holy pilgrimage centres across India. Apply at Sewa Kendra.
answer_pa: ਮੁੱਖ ਮੰਤਰੀ ਤੀਰਥ ਯਾਤਰਾ ਸਕੀਮ ਅਧੀਨ ਸ਼੍ਰੀ ਹਜ਼ੂਰ ਸਾਹਿਬ, ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਸਰ, ਵਾਰਾਣਸੀ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਲਾਸਰ ਵਰਗੇ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਅਸਥਾਨਾਂ ਲਈ ਏਸੀ ਟਰੇਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੁਫਤ ਯਾਤਰਾ, ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼ ਅਤੇ ਲੰਗਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री तीर्थ यात्रा योजना के तहत राज्य के नागरिकों को पवित्र तीर्थ स्थलों की एसी ट्रेनों में मुफ्त यात्रा, ठहरने और भोजन की सुविधा दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Mukh Mantri Tirath Yatra me senior citizens ko Sri Hazur Sahib, Varanasi aadi pilgrimage places ki AC train travel aur stay 100% free milta hai.

name: Punjab Canal Water Irrigation Expansion
benefit: Restoration of canal water to tail-end farms with 90% government subsidy for laying underground irrigation pipelines to conserve groundwater.
eligibility: Farmers and cultivators in Punjab owning agricultural land along canal command distributaries.
documents: Land Fard/Jamabandi, Aadhaar Card, Water Source Certificate.
answer_en: Punjab Canal Irrigation project provides canal water to tail-end fields and up to 90% subsidy on underground irrigation pipelines. Apply at District Soil Conservation Office.
answer_pa: ਪੰਜਾਬ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਨਹਿਰੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਟੇਲਾਂ ਤੱਕ ਪਹੁੰਚਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਜ਼ਮੀਨਦੋਜ਼ ਪਾਈਪਲਾਈਨਾਂ ਪਾਉਣ ਲਈ 90% ਸਬਸਿਡੀ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
answer_hi: पंजाब नहर जल परियोजना के तहत अंतिम छोर तक नहरी पानी पहुंचाया जा रहा है और भूमिगत पाइपलाइन बिछाने पर 90% तक की सब्सिडी दी जा रही है।
answer_hinglish: Punjab Canal Irrigation me tail-end fields tak canal water deliver kiya jaata hai aur underground pipeline pe 90% subsidy milti hai.

name: Doorstep Citizen Services (1076 Delivery)
benefit: Doorstep delivery of 43+ official government services (birth/death certificates, caste/income certificates, driving licence renewal) via helpline 1076 at a scheduled appointment.
eligibility: All citizens resident in Punjab.
documents: Service-specific documents as informed during booking via 1076.
answer_en: Dial 1076 to get 43+ government certificates, licences, and pension papers processed and delivered directly at your home by visiting government assistants.
answer_pa: ਹੈਲਪਲਾਈਨ 1076 ਡਾਇਲ ਕਰਕੇ ਜਾਤੀ, ਆਮਦਨ ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਟ, ਡਰਾਈਵਿੰਗ ਲਾਇਸੈਂਸ ਵਰਗੀਆਂ 43 ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਘਰ ਬੈਠੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰੋ।
answer_hi: हेल्पलाइन 1076 डायल करके जन्म, जाति, आय प्रमाण पत्र जैसी 43 सरकारी सेवाएं अपने घर पर बैठे-बैठे प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।
answer_te: హెల్ప్‌లైన్ 1076 ద్వారా పంజాబ్‌లో 43 రకాల ప్రభుత్వ సర్టిఫికెట్లు మరియు లైసెన్సులను పౌరులు తమ ఇంటి వద్దకే తెప్పించుకోవచ్చు.
answer_hinglish: Toll-free 1076 dial karke 43+ government certificates (caste, income, driving licence) apne ghar pe deliver karwa sakte hain.

name: CM Di Yogshala Scheme
benefit: 100% free certified government yoga instructors provided at parks, community halls, or neighbourhoods when a group of 25+ citizens request via missed call.
eligibility: Groups of 25 or more citizens residing in any village, town, or city in Punjab.
documents: No documents needed. Give a missed call on 7669400500.
answer_en: CM Di Yogshala sends a certified government yoga instructor to teach free daily yoga to any group of 25+ citizens in Punjab. Dial 7669400500 to book.
answer_pa: ਸੀ ਐਮ ਦੀ ਯੋਗਸ਼ਾਲਾ ਤਹਿਤ 25 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਮੂਹ ਲਈ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਮੁਫਤ ਯੋਗਾ ਟ੍ਰੇਨਰ ਭੇਜਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਬੁੱਕ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ 7669400500 'ਤੇ ਕਾਲ ਕਰੋ।
answer_hi: सीएम दी योगशाला के तहत 25 से अधिक लोगों के समूह के लिए सरकार मुफ्त योग प्रशिक्षक भेजती है। 7669400500 पर मिस्ड कॉल दें।
answer_te: సీఎం ది యోగశాల పథకం కింద 25 మందికి పైగా ఉన్న సమూహాలకు ప్రభుత్వం ఉచిత యోగా శిక్షకులను వారి నివాస ప్రాంతాలకే పంపుతుంది.
answer_hinglish: CM Di Yogshala me 25+ citizens ke group ke liye government certified yoga trainer free of cost send karti hai daily practice ke liye.

name: Bihar Post Matric Scholarship (PMS Online)
benefit: Full reimbursement of college tuition fees plus maintenance allowance up to ₹15,000 to ₹1,00,000 per year for intermediate, degree, engineering, and medical students.
eligibility: SC, ST, BC, and EBC students permanent residents of Bihar pursuing post-matric studies with family income under ₹3 Lakh.
documents: Caste Certificate, Income Certificate under ₹3L, Residential Certificate, Fee Receipt, Bonafide Certificate, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Bihar Post Matric Scholarship reimburses college fees and maintenance allowance up to ₹1 Lakh/year for backward class students. Apply on pmsonline.bih.nic.in.
answer_hi: बिहार पोस्ट मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति योजना के तहत एससी, एसटी, बीसी और ईबीसी छात्रों को कॉलेज की पूरी फीस और ₹15,000 से ₹1 लाख तक का रखरखाव भत्ता मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: Bihar Post Matric Scholarship me backward class students ko college tuition fee reimbursement aur allowance milta hai pmsonline portal pe.
